commits_info.message:
[i804] @UtilityClass fails to properly initialize fields (which @UtilityClass makes static) with initializers, in eclipse.

also updates the changelog more generally, it was lacking some recent work.
Updated to patcher 0.20 with updates for bugs where you’d type a quote and then eclipse would hang.
fixed the ‘cleanup/codeformat on save’ save cleanup action in Eclipse Mars.
[i802] working on eclipse mars support; this needs a few updates to integration with patcher.
since Eclipse Mars and the Oomph installer, the structure of eclipse on macs looks different. Installer updated to account for this.
We are getting some reports that might indicate there’s a race condition in loading shadowclassloader. This should fix that.

A capital/lowercase letter messup in a test file means people on case sensitive file systems had problems running tests. Fixed it by renaming the whole file, as I know renames on case INsensitive file systems to fix capitalization usually doesn’t work well either.
